name: Auto Commit Bot

on:
  schedule:
    # Every 5 minutes (GitHub minimum). Runs will average ~6-7 min due to jitter step.
    - cron: '*/5 * * * *'
  workflow_dispatch: # manual trigger for testing

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: auto-commit
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  auto-commit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          token: ${{ secrets.PAT_TOKEN }}

      - name: Configure Git
        run: |
          git config user.name "Om-mac"
          git config user.email "tapdiyaom@users.noreply.github.com"

      - name: Determine next commit message
        id: next
        run: |
          set -e

          TOTAL=$(wc -l < .github/commit-messages.txt | xargs)
          # Number of commits AFTER the initial commit on main
          COUNT=$(git rev-list --count HEAD)
          # Subtract 1 for the very first "first commit"
          INDEX=$((COUNT - 1))

          echo "Total messages: $TOTAL"
          echo "Existing commits: $COUNT"
          echo "Next index: $INDEX"

          if [ "$INDEX" -ge "$TOTAL" ]; then
            echo "done=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "All $TOTAL messages already used."
            exit 0
          fi

          # sed is 1-based; INDEX is 0-based
          LINE=$((INDEX + 1))
          MSG=$(sed -n "${LINE}p" .github/commit-messages.txt)

          # GitHub Actions outputs need escaping for newlines — our messages are single-line, fine.
          {
            echo "message=$MSG"
            echo "index=$INDEX"
            echo "done=false"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

          echo "Will commit: $MSG"

      - name: Jitter to average ~6-7 min between runs
        if: steps.next.outputs.done == 'false'
        run: |
          # Skip ~25% of runs so the average interval is ~6-7 minutes
          if [ $((RANDOM % 4)) -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "Skipping this run for jitter."
            echo "skip=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "skip=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi
        id: jitter

      - name: Make a change and commit
        if: |
          steps.next.outputs.done == 'false' &&
          steps.jitter.outputs.skip == 'false'
        run: |
          MSG="${{ steps.next.outputs.message }}"

          # Append to activity log so we have a real diff
          echo "[$(date -u '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S UTC')] $MSG" >> activity.log

          git add activity.log
          git commit -m "$MSG"
          git push origin HEAD:${{ github.ref_name }}
